title: LiveVoiceParams
description: VibeVoice-Realtime 0.5B voice preset. file_stem matches <file_prefix>-<Name>_<gender>.pt. file_prefix is the filename token (de, en, fr, in, it, jp, kr, nl, pl, pt, sp). language on the voice is the BCP-47 tag for that prefix. experimental is true for every prefix except built-in en and in, including Spk0/Spk1 files that sit at the streaming_model root. preset_kind kv_cache is the serialized prefilled prompt. single_speaker is required. weights_only is true. model_revision is null until the upstream revision is pinned, so these presets are not runnable. Output sample rate lives on the framework, not on the preset.

experimental.description: True for every file prefix except the built-in en and in presets. Not derived from the experimental_voices/ directory.

weights_only.description: Realtime presets are loaded with torch.load(..., weights_only=True).

model_revision.description: Upstream realtime-model revision this KV cache was built for. Null until that revision is pinned.
